text: ニュースも　たくさんの　ひとに　よんでもらえて　うれしかろう！

structure.jp: たくさんの　ひとに　よんでもらえて
structure.en: getting to be read by lots of people

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.explanation: もらう after a て-form verb says you get someone to do the thing for you, and に shows who does it. もらえる means you are able to get that. ひとに　よんでもらえて = 'being able to have people read it'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: かろう in place of the last い is an old-fashioned way to say だろう, 'probably is'. うれしかろう = 'it must be glad'.

patterns.name: 〜て (reason)
patterns.span: よんでもらえて　うれしかろう
patterns.explanation: The て-form before a feeling gives the reason for that feeling. よんでもらえて　うれしかろう = 'it must be glad because it gets read'.
